analysis.headline: Musk pledges to give every US child one SpaceX share
analysis.summary: Elon Musk said he plans to give one SpaceX share to every child in the US, starting next year according to one report. The shares are valued at more than $10 billion, or about 1% of Musk's net worth, based on an estimated 72 million US children.
